title: Cash Runway Forecast (template)
subtitle: Sample numbers for a made-up person. Replace them with your own: everything below is adjustable, and unchecking a bill shows what cutting it does.
controlNote: Start with today's checking balance. Paychecks repeat every two weeks from the first payday until the last paycheck date. Variable spending is set by category in the budget section and spread evenly per day.

labels.ui: Unemployment benefit / week (after pay ends, 2-wk wait) — optional
labels.venmoBal: Other cash to add (e.g. a payment-app balance)

items.name: Gas heating (seasonal)
items.note: Different amount each month: higher in winter.

items.name: Gym membership
items.note: Marked 'verify' to show how unconfirmed items look.

items.name: Pest control (quarterly)
items.note: Quarterly charges use a list of months and a day.

items.name: INCOME: Side gig
items.note: Negative amounts are income. Turn on if it's steady.

caveats: This is sample data. Download the template, replace the values with your own, and import it.

Rules for when a bill hits: {"m": 15} is monthly on the 15th; {"months": [1,7], "d": 10} is those months on the 10th; {"dates": ["2027-02-06"]} is specific days. Add "from"/"to" (YYYY-MM) to limit the months.
Last paycheck date and the scenarios can be a date ("2027-01-15") or a number of paychecks left (0 = none).
Budget rows are [id, label, lean, typical, bare-bones, description]. 'Typical' is the starting value.
